02 / About

Hello,
I’m Fernando.

I’ve spent my career making the complicated feel simple in regulated, legacy-heavy environments.

I’m a product designer with deep roots in fintech, compliance, and data-heavy financial products. I believe we’re moving from designing interfaces to designing systems that think—from static UI to agentic experiences where the designer’s job is to make invisible intelligence feel human and trustworthy.

This portfolio focuses on craft and outcomes. Methods and strategy are better discussed in person.
